description: One plain OpenAI chat completion inside a manual generation that records usage_details, cost_details, model parameters, and completion_start_time.
notes: Langfuse 5.1.0 exports to {base_url}/api/public/otel/v1/traces. base_url is the receiver origin. LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY is capture-public-key and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY is capture-secret-key. LANGFUSE_MEDIA_UPLOAD_ENABLED is false. LANGFUSE_OTEL_COMPRESSION is none and the client also passes otel_compression none, because the receiver rejects a non-identity content encoding and the SDK default is gzip. There is no separate anonymous-telemetry switch in 5.1.0. The client installs its own tracer provider, so the scenario does not call harness.setup. One span, weather-generation, on scope langfuse-sdk 5.1.0. The OpenAI client is the plain SDK, so the span does not copy provider usage and there is no second span. usage_details is written as input 24, output 12, input_cached_tokens 8, and output_reasoning_tokens 3. cost_details is written as input 1, output 2, and total 3. model.parameters is temperature 0 and max_tokens 64. completion_start_time is the current UTC time after the mock returns. The SDK JSON-encodes that datetime, so the attribute is a quoted RFC 3339 string with microseconds and a Z suffix, listed as rfc3339. Pins N21 usage, reported cost (D109), and time to first token.
